# React Magic UI

> Animated, copy-paste components for React built with Tailwind CSS and Motion.

## components

- [Marquee](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/marquee): An infinite scrolling component that can be used to display text, images, or videos. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/marquee.json

## special-effects

- [Border Beam](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/border-beam): An animated beam of light which travels along the border of its container. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/border-beam.json

## animations

- [Blur Fade](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/blur-fade): Blur fade in and out animation. Used to smoothly fade in and out content. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/blur-fade.json

## buttons

- [Shimmer Button](https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/docs/components/shimmer-button): A button with a shimmering light which travels around the perimeter. Registry: https://yousefkadah.github.io/react-animation-library/r/shimmer-button.json
